evidence.claim: The river averages 40 feet across, with pools and underwater cover. The Forest Service describes its watershed as moderately stable, so the water is slow to become turbid.
evidence.quote: The Williams is an intermediate-sized stream with an average width of 40 feet. Excellent pools and in-stream cover exist. Stream alkalinity is moderately good and aquatic insects are diverse and abundant. Because the watershed is moderately stable, the stream is slow to become turbid.

flags: Cache gives no road construction history; the history paragraph describes changes to the river corridor and its protection.
